meta.title: Two Parks and a Late Bus

paragraphs: On Thursday morning, Lily and May waited at the bus stop. It was a cool morning, and the road was busy. A sign said, "Delay: ten minutes." "A delay again!" said May. "Let's use the time to discuss the next club trip," said Lily. "Teacher Kim wants us to choose between two parks." "We must decide today, because the club meets this afternoon."

"The town park is not far," said May. "We can walk there in ten minutes." Lily looked at her watch. "It has a lake with white swans," said Lily. "I saw four swans there last month." "The nature park is much bigger," said May. "It also has a small stream and a lot of trees." "But it is far, so we must take the bus." "The ride is twenty minutes." "The town park is not as quiet as the nature park," said Lily. "It has a road next to it."

"What can we do in the nature park?" asked May. "We can take a tour," said Lily. "Ranger Mark will be our guide." "The tour takes two hours, and we will see many birds." "In the town park, we can only walk around the lake." "That is more boring," said May. "But the swans are beautiful," said Lily. "Maybe they are more beautiful than the birds in the nature park."

"Our last trip was successful," said May. "At the beginning of the year, we went to the town park." "Everybody liked it, and Leo drew the swans." "So I think a new place is better," said May. "Do you agree?" Lily thought about it for a moment. "Yes," said Lily. "A long bus ride is not a problem if we sing on the bus."

A blue bus came around the corner. "Here is the bus," said May. The driver said hello to the girls. "It is ten minutes late, just like the sign." "Then the sign was right," said Lily with a smile. "I choose the nature park." "Me, too," said May. "We will tell Teacher Kim at the club hour."
